Tess (PM): short sync: we need a defensible rollout ladder for the new priority-routing feature. objectives: protect SLAs, let sales opt-in customers, measurable A/B, quick fallback. ideas? :memo:
Arjun (SRE): agree. propose explicit safety ladder: shadow -> small tenant warmup -> regional canary -> 50-tenant A/B -> global. every step has gates: p95, error-rate, cost.
Marta (Backend): implementation notes: flags at three scopes: global, tenant, experiment-assignment. variants: priority_v2, baseline_v1. will add a per-tenant throttle + token budget check.
Tess (PM): opt-in model for customers. sales needs guaranteed opt-out. we should provide an "auto-opt-out-on-breach" toggle.
Clara (Sales): customers will want a SLA addendum. can we promise automatic opt-out + 48h postmortem? that helps close enterprise deals.
Arjun (SRE): automatic opt-out is fine if runbook exists. runtime safety: circuit-breaker per-tenant, kill-switch that flips global flag, and ops-bot incident workflow to notify on-call.
ops-bot: created scheduled job: priority-rollout-heartbeat. will post progress every 10m during rollout windows and open incident if safety gates trip.
Marta (Backend): sample flag yaml we'll ship in PR: ```
flags:
  priority_routing:
    enabled: true
    rollout: { phase: "regional_canary", regions: ["us-west-2"] }
    experiments: { name: "priority_ab_week1", split: 0.5 }
    fallback: "baseline_v1"
```
Tess (PM): GA acceptance criteria draft: 1) autopilot fallback exercised in staging 2) A/B shows no >0.5% error delta 3) legal + sales SLA wording approved 4) runbook for surgical re-enable ready 5) telemetry: per-tenant p50/p95, tokens/sec, fallback count.
Arjun (SRE): testing checklist: 24h shadow run, synthetic spike test, failure-injection that triggers fallback, and cost simulation. add warm windows (02:00-06:00 UTC) for cache priming.
Clara (Sales): I'll collect opt-in list and prepare customer comms template. include opt-out SLA and re-enable SLA (2-4 hours with on-call approval).
Marta (Backend): will add quick rollback curl snippet to PR and a cost-safety hook that pauses experiment if projected extra token cost > $3k/day for tenant-group.
Tess (PM): action items: Marta -> flags PR + rollback snippet (today), Arjun -> circuit-breaker + ops-bot rule + dashboards (EOD), Clara -> comms + opt-in list (tomorrow), I'll draft GA doc and schedule shiproom. target: start regional canary next Wed.
Arjun (SRE): one ask: surface a "canary red button" in console for quick kill-switch with audit trail. saved us before.
Tess (PM): agreed. adding to acceptance. thanks team :rocket:
